metrics.measure: Annual average unemployed as percent of civilian labor force
metrics.denominator: Civilian labor force among civilian noninstitutional people age 16 and over
metrics.cadence: Calendar-year annual average to next calendar-year annual average
metrics.limits: Selected years only; national household-survey rate is not a state, county, or town rate. The 2025 BLS annual row excludes October 2025 and is intentionally not used. The 2019-to-2022 gap is not a measured movement.

metrics.measure: Annual change in national PCE price index
metrics.denominator: Prior calendar-year annual PCE price index; national consumer expenditures, not a state cost-of-living index
metrics.limits: Each observation is a price-level growth rate, not a price-index level. Equal reported growth rates do not mean no price movement. Two adjacent national years are too narrow to establish a normal inflation range. BEA estimates are revised; use a consistent vintage before any runtime calibration.

metrics.measure: Annual average regular gasoline retail price, all formulations
metrics.denominator: U.S. annual average retail price per gallon, including taxes
metrics.cadence: Calendar-year annual average to next calendar-year annual average
metrics.limits: Selected national annual averages, not local pump prices or within-year peaks. The 2019-to-2023 gap is not a measured movement; the 2022 spike and subsequent fall are not included in this illustrative range.

metrics.measure: Gallup average approval of President Biden's job performance
metrics.cadence: Presidential year, approximately January 20 to following January 19; not calendar year
metrics.limits: One presidency, two transitions, rounded polling averages. These numbers are not approval for a generic president and say nothing about any governor. A change in incumbent, survey method, or population needs a new source.

metrics.measure: Berkeley IGS Poll approval of the governor's overall job performance
metrics.denominator: California registered voters surveyed by Berkeley IGS Poll; includes respondents with no opinion
metrics.cadence: Irregular polls; the two comparisons span about 11 and 15 months, respectively
metrics.limits: California only. This is not a regular annual series, and poll sampling error and changing political context matter. Do not transfer these changes to another governor or silently annualize them. The source's historical trend table is used consistently because a standalone 2023 tabulation reports a different rounded October 2023 topline.

metrics.measure: Audited ending General Fund fund balance after transfers
metrics.denominator: Reported General Fund ending balance, including restricted fund balance; the earlier year is restated
metrics.limits: One audited California fiscal-year transition, not a budget deficit, free cash, or an operating surplus. FY2025 includes $18.3 billion restricted for budget stabilization. This large-state dollar amount is not portable to another state or a fictional budget.

unknownContract.reason: No cited same-measure observation for the requested jurisdiction and period
unknownContract.instruction: Keep the world value unchanged or unresolved until a jurisdiction-matched source and explicit simulation rule exist; do not substitute a national rate, California example, zero, or a random draw.
